title: AI assistant
disclaimer: Expenzo AI provides suggestions based on your data. It is not a licensed financial advisor.

refusals.outOfScope: I can only help with your Expenzo finances: spending, budgets, categories, income, balance, savings, transactions, reports and recurring bills. Ask a question about your own data.
refusals.promptInjection: I can't help with hidden instructions, internal context, secrets or requests to override my rules. Ask about your finances in Expenzo.
refusals.tooLong: That message is too long. Ask a shorter question about your Expenzo finances.
refusals.empty: Type a question about your Expenzo finances.
refusals.cooldown: Wait a few seconds before sending another question.
refusals.contextUnavailable: I can't read your finance data right now. Try again shortly.

errors.contextFailed: Couldn't load your finance data. Try again.
